title: DepEd expands school healthcare access for 47,000 beneficiaries

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Over 47,000 target beneficiaries may now access primary healthcare services after the Department of Education (DepEd) led a nationwide health drive on Monday across 91 public school campuses in 85 cities and provinces, transforming local campuses into primary healthcare hubs.
